paragraphs: Bakers arrive before dawn to preheat ovens, measure ingredients, and mix dough. While it proofs, they prepare ingredients and shape products. They inspect the first batch for color and crumb structure, bake and restock through the day, organize inventory, clean the workspace, and calculate the next day's needs before leaving.

AI will not replace bakers, but it will reduce standardized production roles. Central kitchens and automated lines mass-produce toast and rolls, shifting bakers from standard volume toward flavor development, artisan bread, and in-store experiences. People limited to basic mass production face the most pressure, while bakers with product-development skills and craftsmanship become more valuable.
